name: bitbucket_run_pipeline
description: Runs one custom Bitbucket pipeline (a deploy, a build) on a branch, at its newest commit or at a given one. Unless the user listed that repository and pipeline as bypass, it runs NOTHING: it leaves the exact request in the chat with Approve and Dismiss, and only the user's click starts it. Use it only after the user confirmed the repository, branch and pipeline; take the pipeline name from bitbucket_pipelines with options=true. Calling it twice starts two runs, so never repeat a call that succeeded. Returns the run's number and link, or the request waiting for the user.

repo.description: Repository slug, as bitbucket_repos shows it (e.g. api-orders).

ref.description: Branch to run it on (e.g. develop).

pipeline.description: Custom pipeline name, as bitbucket_pipelines options=true shows it (e.g. deploy-dev).

commit.description: Commit hash from bitbucket_commits (e.g. 3f9c2a1b7d4e). Leave it out for the newest commit on ref.
